4. Fixed missing “Forfeit” button in Divine Path mode

Please refer to the in-game announcements for the exact update time, and plan your schedule accordingly

Don’t forget to add Superball to your Steam wishlist for the latest updates and events. See you on the court!

notes.title: Dawn Test Patch Update Announcement
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a new update for Superball, bringing several improvements and features based on your feedback. Here's what's new:​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/115ea3304a61d3a3ce15b9129e90e9c67bb4ed45.jpg[/img]
[h3]🥅 Ranked Mode – AI Removal[/h3]
In response to player feedback, we've removed AI-controlled players from Ranked matches. This change ensures a more authentic competitive experience. We initially introduced AI to reduce wait times, but we've listened to your concerns and are committed to enhancing the integrity of Ranked play.​

[h3]🏟️ Lobby Enhancements[/h3]
The lobby now displays all ongoing matches

[h3]👀Spectator Mode[/h3]
You can now select any active match from the lobby to watch

[h3]🎮 Gameplay & UI Improvements[/h3]
[*] Optimized lighting and shadow effects to improve the game's visual appeal.​
[*] The channel switch button has been changed to the 'Tab' key.​
[*] Continued improvements to the text filtering system.​

[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h3]
Resolved an issue where duplicate match entries were appearing in the history.​

[h3]🔮 Looking Ahead[/h3]
We appreciate your participation in the Dawn Test and the valuable feedback you've provided. We're actively working on addressing key areas:

[list]
[*] [b]Match Spectating Feature[/b]: To alleviate long waiting times during matchmaking, we are introducing a feature that allows players to spectate ongoing matches or watch replays during the matchmaking process.​
[*] [b]Charge Shot Range Adjustment[/b]: Based on player feedback, we are reverting the increase in charge shot range. Charging will no longer extend the range of the shot.​
[*] [b]Item Balance Changes[/b]: Reduced the distance of the Flash ability, flash can no longer be used inside the penalty area; Goalkeepers will now resist the effects of the Electromagnetic Projectile within the penalty area.​
[*] [b]Goalkeeper Experience and Matchmaking Improvements[/b]: We are working on enhancing the goalkeeper experience and adjusting the difficulty for new players in ranked matches. Efforts to reduce the defensive pressure on goalkeepers are also underway.
[/list]

[h3]📢 Help Us Grow[/h3]
If you're enjoying Superball, please consider adding it to your Steam wishlist and inviting friends to join the fun. Your support helps us reach more players and continue improving the game.​

Thank you for being part of the Superball community!
The Superball Team

notes.title: Superball April 2025 Developer Log
notes.content:
Dear Ballers,

Time flies—it’s already 2025, and it’s been a while since our last developer log. Today, we’re reviving this series to chat openly with all Superball fans about what we’ve been working on.

During this quiet period, our team has been tirelessly refining core mechanics, polishing the experience, and preparing exciting new content. We’ve also been listening closely to your feedback, striving to deliver a bigger, bolder, and better Superball!

Among your suggestions, recurring themes stood out: “Not enough game modes,” “Steep learning curve,” and “New players need more support.” We take these concerns seriously. After all, every game thrives when players of all skill levels can enjoy it—especially since mid- to low-tier players form the backbone of any community.

So, let’s talk about the solution: [b]Divine Path[/b] (Tentative Name)—a brand-new casual mode designed to lower the entry barrier while adding chaotic fun!

[h3]What is Divine Path?[/h3]
This fresh 3v3 playground swaps sweaty competition for wild, unpredictable battles. Think of it as a “rogue-lite lite” twist on Superball:

[h3]3v3 | Random Maps | 7-Minute Matches | Random Upgrades[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/78c4a43931c75dded50fc841446154e45e7c9027.gif[/img]
(Early test build—subject to change)

[list]
[*] Pre-match: Pick your favorite hero.
[*] Earn Bucky Coins (Tentative Name): Collect currency mid-match through goals, assists, or flashy plays.
[*] Post-Goal Power Spikes: After scoring, spend Bucky Coins to buy Enhancements (Tentative Name)—temporary buffs like invisibility, super-speed, or even game-breaking items.
[*] Overtime Thrills: Tied score? Sudden death—first goal wins!
[*] Level the Field: Enhancements narrow the skill gap. Imagine sneaking past “pros” with an invisibility dribble!
[/list]
[h3]Enhancements Deep Dive[/h3]
Q1: What are Bucky Coins?
A1: Earned during matches based on performance (goals, saves, etc.), these let you buy Enhancements post-goal. Play well = More coins!

Q2: What Enhancements exist?
A2: Categories include:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/e73931fdb1193708aab576e35426345481a84e53.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/9a806707e4bbff0d5a58ea9d9654816fbf755754.png[/img]

All Enhancements display clear in-game descriptions.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
Mark your calendars:
[list]
[*] April 24, 2025: Superball joins Steam’s Eastern Game Fest with a free demo!
[*] Wishlist us on Steam—it’s crucial for our visibility!
[*] Stay tuned for more updates via future logs or our Discord!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/755cd156c129cb75b102e608695dc49dd6648fdf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: September Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings fellow buckyballers![/h2]

Time for another developer update! 

The developer stream yesterday was a total blast! We showcased plenty of fresh elements, optimizations and of course, a new goalkeeper that is coming to SBT very soon!

In this dev update, we'll give players a rundown of all the major elements discussed during this event, again, feel free to comment and let us know what you think about it :)

[h2][b]Hallie, welcome to the party![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/960741143165d9e6152d7ac3196eb5b57d8eb8f1.jpg[/img]

A new goalkeeper is finally coming into the game! Covered by futuristic robotic arms, Hallie is a military personnel equipped with the latest tech. As our first-ever female goalie, the addition will add more depth and diversity into the current roster. 

It'll still take us a while to add her into the official game, as Hallie still needs to go through rigorous testing, as well as visual optimizations. More details about her skillset will be revealed at a later date. 

[h2][b]Adjustments on General Abilities[/b][/h2]

In July update, we've made a big change to the gameplay by removing the item system completely while adding general abilities (GA) that players can select before the match started. Based on the feedback received throughout the testing period, we've decided to continue to adjust the system to make it more strategic and fun to play. 

In the upcoming version, each player will be able to select 2 GA before the match started. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RyNRHlc.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, we've redesigned the system so that each GA will only have a set amount of usage per match. 

On top of that, the new build we're currently testing on will have a universal cooldown for pretty much all GA. For instance, the rocket fist ability will only have 1 time of usage during a match, with 30 seconds universal cooldowns between each usage. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nO61VnP.gif[/img]

We're also planning on adding some perks into the game so players can pick up and receive a bonus usage of their GA. Moreover, the GA lineup will also be expanded to make sure a wide range of selections for all players. 

[h2][b]Character Optimizations[/b][/h2]

You've probably already heard the enlarged stadiums and optimized aiming system, as discussed in the August Developer Update.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2986436715041579613
Along with these changes, the team have decided to revaluate current characters and adjust their abilities to fit with the new aiming mechanic and further optimize gameplay experience.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fq1ZS8b.gif[/img]

This includes skin special effects, ultimate optimizations, balancing changes and more.

notes.title: August Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings fellow buckyballers![/h2]

Hope you’re having a great day! 

[h3]We've just released the long waited July Beta Top 10 Plays last week, check it out if you haven't already![/h3]
[previewyoutube=XTQ1OLpGbCU;full]https://youtu.be/XTQ1OLpGbCU[/previewyoutube]
So it’s been about a month since we last update you with the news of Super Buckyball Tournament, for the past month, the team has been testing out some new stuff, as well as optimizing the gameplay experiences. We'd like to go through some of the changes that are coming to SBT, feel free to let us know what you feel about it in the comment section!

[h2][b]Enlarged Stadiums[/b][/h2]

Probably the biggest change to the gameplay in August is the increase in the size of the stadium.
We've decided to increase the size of all existing stadiums proportionally, making it [b]30% larger[/b] than the previous ones. To compare, the previous 4v4 stadium is 20% larger than the regular one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0e41e0a6110efd5a94d01b158ecca45f960616d2.jpg[/img]

[b]We've made this change based on several reasons. [/b]

-	Highlights the importance of players positions 
-	Allows for more time & space to organize teamplay
-	Need bigger field to implement mechanics such as grant ball possessions to the side who’ve conceded the goal 
-	Reduce the amount of combat & passes that will get deflected around the wall 

We tried all kinds of sizes and felt like 30% is a perfect balance. The overall game pace will be slightly slower, but not significant enough to spoil the gameplay. 

Players will have a bit more time to hold on to the ball, allowing for more teamplay opportunities.

Positions have never been so important in this new version, since running through the whole map chasing the ball back and forth will be much harder following this adjustment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/daf9ed73ddb9e7f5c8c7e74fd0cd71a010202e32.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Optimized Aiming System[/b][/h2]

Another part of our work mainly focusing on optimizing the aiming system.

There have been loads of feedbacks (mostly from new players) ever since the Preseason, suggesting to improve the aiming system while adding a crosshair. 

As a result, Dot Crosshair has been added to the game, as well as a mechanic called Shooting Corrections. 

[b]Dot Crosshair[/b]

While the crosshair has been finally made into the game, be aware that it functioned a bit differently compared to traditional FPS games.

Of course, you can still use it to help aim the top or bottom corners of the goal, however, since characters in SBT all have it’s own shot accuracy stats, the final shot will likely end up being off-target.
 
Unless you mastered the perfect punch mechanic, which at the moment is only available for R47. The plan is to expand the perfect punch to other characters as well in the later updates.

[u]Demonstration from R47 using controller, with the perfect punch[/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vimTrF1.gif[/img]

[b]Shooting Corrections[/b]

The purpose of add in Shooting Corrections is more for new players and players with controllers, who find it difficult to aim precisely while controlling character & camera at the same time. 

When having the ball, players shoot will be corrected only if the direction where the character is facing is within a reasonable angle with the camera. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GsHr2Kp.gif[/img]

This change will significantly reduce the learning curve for beginners. while for seasoned players, it’s expected that this change should not effect them at all.

[h2][b]Optimized Camera[/b][/h2]

The last tweak we've made to SBT this time around is the camera optimizations.

If you rotate the camera in different angles, you'll find that in many times, the camera will move further away from players, offering a wider view angle to observe opponents from behind, as well as providing a better vision for long-range passing in enlarged stadiums.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lsu70Hq.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've also adjusted the Ball Cam to make the overall transitions smoother, more details on that later.

[h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]

While the release date and business model still need to be discussed internally, it’s almost certain that there’ll not be a public open Beta event prior to the Early Access release.

You can still enjoy the Singleplayer version of the game by downloading the Demo on our Steam page, we’re also planning on hosting small-sized closed Beta testing occasionally through our official [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw][b]Discord[/b][/url] server, join now if you haven’t already so you can participate when it’s live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/68fd0ed35300450a076154feafee4c23cdd6dd77.png[/img]

We plan to release regular dev update every month, as a result of this, the bi-weekly AMA on Discord will be temporarily paused. You can reach out to us through Steam Community, [url=https://twitter.com/SuperBuckyBall][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw][b]Discord[/b][/url]. Stay tuned for our next dev log at the end of next month for more exciting updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059110/
SBT Development Team

notes.title: Singleplayer Career Mode - Start Your Journey To The Top!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Let’s talk about the new Singleplayer Career Mode available starting tomorrow's July BETA![/b][/h3]

In Singleplayer, you are the manager of a Super Buckyball team starting at the bottom but vying for gold in a 4-tier tournament. Recruit players, hone your team, and be the winners this season! 

You’ll be able to control all 3 of your players on the field and swap fluidly between them at the press of a button, giving you full control of the flow of the game and the ability to pull off incredible plays all on your own! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GMxg3eA.gif[/img]

[b]During this BETA, the Singleplayer Mode will end after reaching the 2nd tier and is estimated to have about 5 hours of content when playing standard 4-minute matches, though more content will be on the way in the future.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/3976147aa4fe12c9511e9cc376035be919baa97c.png[/img]

Our three new champions, Murphy, Kenny, and Blade, won’t be available in the Singleplayer Mode during this Beta, but in the future, they’ll be joining our roster of champions, known as star players in Singleplayer Mode. In this career campaign, there will also be many role players to recruit that can help your team rise to the top. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/7c7e62afaedbad67df2b60fa444339b3db4dfdfc.png[/img]

The Transfer Market menu allows you to buy players from other teams or sign them on as free agents, though the Transfer Market is only open during the preseason. After the preseason ends, you’ll have to work on improving the players you’ve got. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5MtNRtG.gif[/img]

Characters cost more to recruit based on their skills and overall rating, with higher rated players costing more, and role players generally being more affordable to recruit than star players. But if you’re able to land some star players, they’ll be valuable assets with more powerful abilities to master and higher growth potential than role players are capable of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/9dbc792264615a04f9a07eccb664469967d93d25.png[/img]

As a rookie in the league, the role and star players that you can afford to start off with will have limited stats and moves, which you can level up and unlock by earning experience from completing matches. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NuyxNDf.gif[/img]

Leveling up earns potential points which you can invest directly into improving your chosen players’ stats, and hitting certain levels will unlock new moves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/fe5638ecd60ee04aa5fe5d2ebf63c91830073884.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/4bcdf7c6b97d41196654e9b7edf5db3c8e198bec.png[/img]

For your players that aren’t currently participating in matches, you can schedule training sessions so that they can level up, too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/77938684d27a6edca291d61971c44a9c28ed9c6f.png[/img]

You can also improve your abilities with equipment from the Equipment Store, though they can cost some hefty coins. Earn more money by winning matches! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/b59308cf7919ef95443c0c9a4791ffa24898d863.png[/img]

There’s more to it, but that’s the gist of Singleplayer Mode. In less than 1 day, you’ll be able to try it out for yourself!

notes.title: June 2021 Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey all buckyballers,[/h2]


[h3]The July BETA is almost there! [/h3] 

While the date for the test is still yet to be announced, we’d like to share some of the latest updates the team is working on recently and the changes to the game that players can expect in the upcoming July. 

[h3]New Character[/h3]

Excited for the new characters? We’ll be able to see 3 new faces joining the game very soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/58a1f00bae3c07e172e181bd077e31a93d951ab7.jpg[/img]

All 3 characters should be revealed later this week so definitely stay tuned if you want to know more about them!

[h3]2v2[/h3]

Here at SBT we’d like to offer players with a variety of experiences, that include new characters, singleplayer and of course more multiplayer game modes. 

Back in February, we introduced 4v4 mode where players get to play in a team of 4 instead of traditional 3 and a lot of feedback have been received ever since. 

This time around we decided to push things even further by adding 2v2 mode into the game. Unlike 4v4, the stadium size in 2v2 still remains the same as the traditional 3v3. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/ade62dda67e0ae509c523bfdc5927c5e5c00a028.png[/img]

With less people on each team, there’ll be a lot more spaces on the map which players could play to their advantage. 

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/5vCtQzd/2v2.gif[/img][/url]

At the moment, both 4v4 and 2v2 game modes are still not well optimized therefore minor issues are expected. We’re looking forward to get players to test the 2v2 and provide valuable feedback after the BETA started. 

[h3]New Lobby Music[/h3]

Other than extra game mode, we’ve also updated the lobby with a new set of background music! It has already become one of my favorite music so far so you should definitely check it out!

[previewyoutube=pOjwtdtI69Y;full]https://youtu.be/pOjwtdtI69Y[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Selection Screen[/h3]

In the previous testing, switching characters and swapping positions in SBT can be really complicated and confusing, especially for beginners. That’s certainly gonna change in the July BETA. 

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/DRTcmm1/UI.gif[/img][/url]

To access the selection screen, simply press the button during pre-match (before the match start), from there players can swap to empty slot or send position swap request to slot that already filled by others. For old players, the temporary slot will still remain in-game. 

Not only you can swap characters and positions in the selection screen, people will also be able to check character abilities and ultimate right in the selection screen. 

We believe adding the selection screen will significantly reduce the learning cost for new players and greatly improve the experiences for everyone participating in the July BETA. 

[h3]General Abilities & Removal of Items In-Game[/h3]

In the upcoming BETA we’ll witness a big change in the gameplay, the items will be removed from the match.

Instead, general abilities are created and players can choose one during the selection screen right before the match started. To balance the system, each general abilities will have different cooldowns times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458276/d132ee1540046a9e0eb49076f5ac99e247d134d1.png[/img]

Out of all the general abilities, some are newly designed but most of them came directly from items. We’ve also decided to move the tackling mechanic into one of the general abilities.

notes.title: Super Buckyball Tournament Development Update
notes.content:
Hi buckyballers,

Are you excited to play the next BETA soon? We would like to get players informed on the latest news and updates about the game, which we already discussed in the AMA last week.   

[b]Early Access Timeline[/b]

We had previously hoped to launch SBT into Early Access this summer, but due to developing reasons, we might have to delay the launch. We are still hoping for a release later this year, and we hope you can understand that we wish to have a more polished game before we dare to release it, as these types of multiplayer games will either make it big or fail completely.

[b]Time for the next BETA?[/b]

The time for the next BETA is not yet set in stone, but we’re currently aiming for July. While everyone are waiting for July, we have decided to host [b]2 Open Weekends[/b], so players can still have fun and enjoy SBT with their friends. The first Open Weekend is scheduled on[b] April 17th and April 18th[/b], during the open weekend we’ll put out the February BETA build for players to play. The second open weekend is scheduled around early June.  

[b]4V4 game mode[/b]

After receiving all the feedback from the survey, we’ve decided to keep the 4V4 game mode as what it is for now. The current idea is not to put it into the arcade mode since it offers the same gameplay experiences as the regular 3V3 mode, but we will revisit further after we launch the game, and it becomes more relevant to support a larger player base. 

[b]Protection zone & Tackling mechanic[/b]

After receiving all your feedback, we’ll keep then in-game and continue to optimize it. 

[b]The future of the item system[/b]

After carefully consider what players have suggested, we decided to make some changes to the item system in the future. We’ll share more details with you guys later.  

[b]Character balance[/b]

Sky will be nerfed in the next BETA for sure, however, the team is not too worried about character balancing at the moment, usually it’s the one of the later thing we do before putting out a BETA. We believe it’s important to improve other parts of the game first as they affect the balancing anyways. And of course before we launch we will be doing extensive balance testing.  

[b]Also a note to all players, since there aren't that many topics to discuss over the next few months leading up to the BETA, we decided to change the current weekly AMA's into bi-weekly, which means there'll be no AMA for this week, we'll be back with you all on [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw]Discord[/url] next week, stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: AMA & more details about upcoming BETA
notes.content:
Hi all Buckyballers, 

In the last AMA on Jan 27 we mainly discussed details about the upcoming beta. The main topics can be seen below.

[b]Taichi girl’s New name:[/b]

In the vote we did, Luna came first at 83 votes, Rin at 63, and Sky and Jade at 47.
Our devs were thinking about the name for a few days after we passed on all the names and their popularity and in the end we choose [b]Sky[/b] as the official name. 

[b]Pretesting and video recording[/b]

We had a pre-testing session over the weekend where 20 players were given special access to the game to help us out by recording a lot of cool footage which we will be cutting up and editing over the next few days and it is planned to air 1-2 hours after the beginning of the steam game festival.
We want to give our thanks to everyone who participated in the pretesting and we value the feedback you have given us which will help us make some last minute important changes before the launch of the beta.

[b]Tournament[/b]

We have set the time and date for the tournament to be on Sunday 7th of February at 11AM PST/ 8PM CET. Apart from this, we're still working on the rules, signup, casting plan etc.
We also want to say thanks to our volunteers for the help and support to help create what we hope to be an awesome experience for everyone. Thanks to @ItsTom @Lark @MrTSeeks @Ally @Jerem !
More updates to the tournament will be posted later, so stay tuned.

[b]R47 Final Skin[/b]

In the Preseason back in November, 1 master grinder from the west made it all the way to the top and completed our battle pass. To honor his hard work and dedication, we are giving SirBlooky the final battle pass lvl 60 skin for R47 for the upcoming beta.

[b]Trivia [/b]

Since Friday, we have been doing a count down to the beta launch, and there are now only 2 days to go. With these countdown posts on our twitter, we are doing daily trivia questions where you can win extra in-game coins to help you get your favorite skins.
Join the trivia here https://twitter.com/SuperBuckyBall

[b]Servers[/b]

Over the past month we were considering whether to run the beta just on the NA server like we did in the open alpha, or to run the beta on multiple servers around the globe.
And we went with option 2 which means you will be able to play on:
Virginia, Frankfurt, Sao Paolo, and Singapore.

[b]Global lobby and leader board[/b]

The server decision brings good news to the leaderboard.

We have now combined the lobby of all the regions (except China) which means that you can add friends from other regions and play on other servers without having to create a new profile. 
This also means that the leaderboards will now be global, and you will be able to compare your performance with players from overseas.

[b]Patchnotes[/b]

Several of you have mentioned to us the importance on patchnotes and how much they are being valued. Since it has been a while since the preseason, there might be a few things we have forgotten. But we will try to add as much as we can.

[b]Content creator Role[/b]

We have written up the #content-creators welcome note. 
We have been happy to see all the content that have been created for the game so far.
And we are planning to make a content creator program once the game launches. Until then we have made the channel #official-content for all creators to post their content in.

[b]Steam Streams[/b]
We will be streaming the pretesting video throughout the beta, but if someone has the desire to make a secondary stream, you would be very welcome. If you are interested, pls contact me and I will help you with the setup process.

[b]Suggestions:[/b]

1.	Make a half time where people can change characters

2.	Beta avatars 

3.	Name banner in the lobby

4.	Flagpoles on each side of the stage with different options flags

5.	Make it possible to pop eriels bubbles by team mates (or only by team mates)

6.	Make a character design template

7.	Ping limit to control crossserver matchmaking
A: We are currently not using this and will look into how complicated it will be to implement

8.	Skin design competitions



[u][b]Based the pretesting there were a few issues we will look into:
[/b][/u]
[b]R47 hitbox got bigger[/b]

- According to the director, the hitbox is still the same size as during the preseason

[b]Bug where the Taiji girl can continually use her retreat ability

notes.content:

[h2]Hey Sandrockers![/h2]

[b]My Time at Sandrock[/b] – Just like My Time at Portia, the game takes place in perhaps the only wholesome post-apocalyptic world in the gaming industry right now; a world where humans have successfully restarted civilization after, long ago, nearly destroying themselves through greed, unbridled technology, and warfare in a period they refer to as the “The Age of Darkness.” Current citizens of this world now band together and reject the Old World ideologies as they work to rebuild, but remaking an entire civilization isn’t easy…

[previewyoutube=aolJ3ZHzhCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]First day on the job…[/b]
Taking a job offer in the frontier town of Sandrock, you’ll assume the role of a fledgling builder being sent to a wild and rugged townscape on the brink of collapse. It’s up to you and your trusty toolset to gather resources, build machines, fix up your workshop into a well-oiled production machine, and save the town from the jaws of economic ruin, as well as a few other unexpected complications...

[b]No job too big, no task too small![/b]
Customize and build your workshop with an intricate set of machines that all work together to produce parts of huge structures for the town that you assemble piece by piece; or head to your worktable to craft hundreds of unique items that can help out individual townspeople or be placed throughout your own workshop: watch Sandrock transform before your eyes as every contribution you make to town appears permanently in the world!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/407e2594aab1688c8ed88127260acc1d2d3b521d.jpg[/img]

[b]There and back again [/b]
Explore the vast deserts surrounding Sandrock: dive into ruins to find ancient relics from the Old World, face the dangers of dungeons and their denizens, then return to your homestead with encumbering bags of treasure in tow. Take your profits and convert the empty prairie lands around you into farmable land for a more leisurely lifestyle, then sell your crops, or transform them into delicious dishes to share with all your new friends in town!
 
[b]It takes a wild bunch…[/b]
The people of Sandrock are hardy and tenacious, and one can hardly survive in such an arduous climate without developing a sense of humor. Befriend the local sheriff to hear about his tall tales, help out the chatty ranch family and they’ll help you in turn, spend some time with a local artist and hear about her hopes and aspirations. Meeting and helping these characters leads to not only making new friends, but also people to support you in building your workshop! And who knows, even romance might be in the air…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/a77e183ee5fd00442fa08a7f4a2b6f562299ea5d.jpg[/img]
 
My Time at Sandrock brings a plethora of new features to the table:
[list]
[*] [b]New Combat[/b] - a revamped combat system that allows the player to quickly shift between melee combat and 3rd person shooting mechanics.
[*] [b]Great Music [/b]- an original soundtrack with dynamic in-game music that reflects where the player is and what they're doing
[*] [b]More Elaborate Story and Deeper Characters[/b]- a vastly enriched storyline, hundreds of side-quests boasting over 30 completely new characters, each getting more attention than before with their own story to discover, as well as the return of a few familiar faces for fans of the series.
[*] [b]Build with Friends! Co-op multiplayer[/b] - Perhaps the most exciting addition to the game is a new multiplayer function that will finally allow players to visit a unique multiplayer map where they can build a workshop together and experience an additional storyline that unfolds there…
[/list]

Fans of the series will find everything they enjoyed about Portia and more, and new players will feel right at home in the delightful life-sim RPG that is My Time at Sandrock.

notes.title: September Update Overview
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Long time no see! Not sure if anyone noticed that there’s little to no information about the major update last month. That’s because after the July patch we’ve announced that the team needs to take some time to further optimize the game while bringing in new exciting content to the SBT community. As a result, we decided to cancel the August update so that the team can put all the hard works and efforts to make the new version happen as soon as possible. 

Moving on to the September update, to prepare for the big patch that’s coming out later, the September update will mainly be focusing on these aspects: game balance, in-game tutorial, surrender system, new item and more skins for characters.

Let’s start off with game balancing first, ever since the July patch there have been numerous messages from players complaining about how strong R47 is under the current meta. We’re fully aware of the whole situation with R47 and other characters but since game balancing takes time, we decided to fix this issue in the next major update (which is in September) so that the team will not be overloaded by tasks at all times. 

In the September update, players can also expect a brand-new item coming into the game. ‘Reverse Ball’ is a defensive-focused item that can reverse the direction of the ball to the opposite side of where it heads to. It’s an advanced item that has a lot to explore and can be used in conjunction with abilities from other characters to score & defend in the dying moments of the match. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/htdJQAh1quqqsiXD8h/giphy.gif[/img]

Another big change coming into September is the in-game tutorials. There have been too many requests about having a proper tutorial system in-game ever since the launch of the open development, and it’s now finally here in September!

The in-game tutorial will allow players to take a few pre-designed practice trials and get a better understanding of the game. 

For old players, we’ve also taken suggestions by adding a practice arena at the end of the tutorial where players can browse items on the field and practice the usage of each item. 

Another new thing we added in-game is the surrender system. As many players have suggested, having a surrender system will help reduces unmeaningful matches. We’re still experimenting with the surrendering mechanics in which it might not be perfect when it first launched but we hope to get better as we go. 

Regarding new skins, we’re planning on having another 2-3 sets of new redeemable skins for each character. Here are some of the previews for the new skins in the next update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/9d8ddedaa3eabae12afdea2427b9a411e7741358.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/343827bd49478c9c99008abaf9387697ffd15ace.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/2b9e2b23187cd666a3b3ba60b9a606be5b18a551.jpg[/img]

Be aware that in the September patch we’ll clean up player coins, while skins that already been bought will still remain in player’s library. So if you happen to have spare coins in your hands, don’t hesitate to spend it right now!

So I think that’s pretty much all the major contents covered in the September update, we fixed & add some of the key things that players have been asking for while saved some time and resources to prepare for more content to deliver in the future. 

A more detailed patch note will be out on the day of the patch where you can expect more optimizations coming into September!

Let us know your thought by talking with us on social media and communities:

notes.title: July Patch Review
notes.content:
The July update should be coming in the next few days and here it's a patch preview on what players can expect out of the July patch!

[h3]New Character: Eriel[/h3]

Back in April when we announced the open development of Super Buckyball Tournament, people got very excited about the mysterious blue-haired girl from the trailer. Since then we constantly had players ask us when she would come out, and now the time has finally come!

We have made a little introduction video for her with a nice summer soundtrack to showcase her skills
Check it here：

[previewyoutube=SdfIw2YekH4;full][/previewyoutube]

Her playstyle can vary as she has a broad range of skills which gives her much control across the field. Our recommendation is to play her as a midfielder to help with disables for supporting either the attacker or the goalie.

Her [b]Fish Cannon[/b] slowly generates 3 different types of bullets over time, which rotates with each new bullet. These 3 different bullets have different effects when blasting them out to teammates & opponents.

Her bullets are:

[b]Bubble Bullet[/b]
Characters who got hit by bubble bullet will be covered in a bubble and stay in the air for a few seconds, they'll not be able to move during the time.

[b]Ink Bullet[/b]
Ink bullet will cause an explosion when it hits the ground. If it hits the character, the ink will block the sights of the player's computer screen.

[b]Buff Bullet[/b]
Eriel and the teammates who got hit by the bullet will receive a buff and will not be knocked down by any abilities and items.

Her ultimate is called [b]Grappling Hook[/b], which she releases the hook from the mouth of the fish in his hand to grab the nearby ball back to her.

While her speed and agility might not be as fast as Pai or Lang, she does have a very strong set of abilities that can easily shift the balance of the game in the heat of the moment.

Compared to our other characters, Eriel is so far the most difficult character to play and it will take some practice to play her well. Her versatility in the game requires the player to have a broad overview of the playing field and since her abilities are not spamable, timing is very essential for domination.

[h3]Skin System[/h3]

Next after Eriel, the skin system is very likely the most desired feature in this update.

As you have noticed we have had coins in the lobby for a while, but no one has been able to use them yet. 
The good news is that you will finally be able to spend to hard-earned coins.
But the bad news is that we will reset everyone’s coins and levels again. 
This does however not hold you back from starting a new fortune.

We have made simple few skins for each character, including Eriel and we have more coming up.
The skins are divided into components for most characters therefore different skins for the same character can be combined into the look that you like the best.

[previewyoutube=3HGrqBykQo0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3HGrqBykQo0[/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=wMDXpElhT3c;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMDXpElhT3c
[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Mission System
[/h3]
So what’s more to come in July? Time to introduce our long-awaited in-game mission system! 

The current plan is to have 3 daily and 3 weekly missions in place, by completing it you receive extra coins to get one step closer to your favourite skin！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/12c4ce8bcbe096f3c387b8792863371a9d878e82.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/eda24d570e17d54d489e60f4a5e4708ae17ee747.png[/img]

Feel free to refresh current missions at any time if you happen to find the mission boring or hard to complete, just be aware that it cost coins every time and you only get 3 chances to refresh per day. 

It’s a quite basic feature by now but we’re hoping to explore more of it in the future, there’ll be exclusive events & activity points system where we giving out a bunch of cool stuff, so stay tuned on our official social media and communities for more!

This Mission system will also be the foundation for a future battle pass, so we would very appreciate feedback on your experiences related to the missions and the system itself as well as suggestions for new missions or for how we can make a cool battle pass later on.

[h3]Pre-assigned Position [/h3]

We’ll also be making a significant adjustment in the matchmaking process, start from the July patch.
After the update players will have to assign themselves into attacking position (which is position 1 or 2 in-game) or defensive position (position 3) in-game. You may also select both if you’re are fine with playing all positions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/4f4b5683fcfc130d04e44e13eef47777bf9bceac.png[/img]

The reason for implementing this is that we got plenty of feedback from players talking about not being able to play the position they desired. Swap position in-game sometimes did not work, either the players on other side do not know how to swap or they both want to play goalie. 

For those who can comfortably fit into any position, this system would not affect them at all, but for players who do care about it, this would improve their gameplay experience by a country mile. 


If you have any good ideas or suggestions, please send you feedback to our discord or sbt@pathea.net 

So that’s all the major things coming out in the July patch, 
We’ll have a much more detailed patch note about the update a bit later, stay tuned have fun in Super Buckyball Tournament!

-	SBT Dev Team

notes.title: June Patch Update Overview
notes.content:
Hey folks, it’s been almost a month since we came out with the May update, which means the June patch is coming out soon!

So today we’re about to give you guys a glimpse on some of the new features that are going to be available when the new patch arrives, also feel free to tell us what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/e114d9a69d081f94b4d12ba002f4a9eddf474010.jpg[/img]


For the patch in June, we’re going to add some long-waited features into the game, including a friend system and team system. But first, let’s talk about the adjustments on game modes that are coming in June.

[b]For those who want to play more competitively, we decided to add a new mode called ‘ranked’ into the game. The new leaderboard will reflect those who played in ranked instead of regular matches. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/65816b67ca870d7a8aa029895f8f5054a9405bcb.jpg[/img]


[b]After the June patch players will be able to see a new mode called ranked and it’ll only be unlocked after players have reached level 7. Be aware that all players data will be reset with the June update, which means even old players will have to reach level 7 (approximate. 5-8 matches) before they are able to play in ranked matches. [/b]


Of course, one of the main issue players might be worried about right away is the lack of players with each individual game mode. We’re totally aware of that and we do believe this is the step we have to make to improve the game in the long run. We’ll also adjust some of the game mode settings to improve the overall experiences for most players. Our team will continue to look closely into players feedbacks while adjusting accordingly. 

[b]Other than the newly added ranked mode, the arrival of the June patch will bring another two long-awaited features: the friend system and the team system.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0439580016de3c7c51c27b49acea4f6dc457807d.jpg[/img]


Start with the friend system, just like the friend system in many other games, players will be able to add friends via their username or user ID. Players can then check their friend’s status (if they are online or not) and message them privately. Players could also find others in which they recently played with under the friend system and send friend requests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0935dc492511184ba70085030e833a1a5fe92e6a.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272741/0da9b61aac2dc3bf9f9c0dee659b558e57d3a7bc.png[/img]


To complement the friend system, we’ll also be adding the team system. The team system allows you to team up with your friends or other players you have recently played with. Each team can have a maximum of 3 players. The team leader can choose to go on regular match or ranked (as for ranked everyone in the team must have reached level 7). 

Compared with other games our friend system and team system are still in the early stages and need a lot of optimizations. We’ll continue to work on these systems and would like our players to provide valuable suggestions on how to make it better. 

[b]Other than these new features, players can also expect a new item in June called ‘swap’. [/b]It is easily the most overpowered items in the game, swap allows players to literally switch position with a nearby opponent. A lot of fun new gameplays will come out of this for sure and we would also love to hear back from you how you fell about this item.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AmSkrtf.gif[/img]


Along with the update we also got our new lobby music, compared to the current music this one definitely had more electronic vibe to it. We’d like to take the opportunity of this open development to test out various lobby music tracks to find the best match. 

[previewyoutube=Q4X1bspvnus;full][/previewyoutube]

I think that’s pretty much all for the important new features in June, let us know what you think! A more detailed changelist and bug fix note will be available once the update is ready to launch next week, stay tuned for that! 

If you still haven’t joined our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BAc8gvw]discord[/url], make sure you join now so that you can stay updated with our latest news!

If you don’t happen to have a discord, don’t worry, you may also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SuperBuckyBall]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/SuperBuckyballTournament]Facebook[/url]!

-	SBT Dev Team

notes.title: May Patch Details - New Character & Stadium!
notes.content:
[b]May Patch[/b]

The May patch is just around the corner and for those of you that haven´t been following us for the past few weeks, here is an update on all the cool things you can expect in a few days.

As you may remember, we announced our newest character Bubba a while back with some information on how we designed him and why we felt the need for such a character.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2233166553097623503

[b]New character[/b]:

Since then we have changed his name to Gridiron, and we feel it sounds way cooler.
What do you guys think?

Here is a more detailed description on how to play this character, with his abilities and basic strategies. As mentioned before, this guy was made to be a goalkeeper and he has quite a few skills designed to make him stronger for this position.

His size: Gridiron is a very wide character and he covers a much larger proportion of the goal. Not only is he the widest character, but he is also the tallest, being a couple of centimetres taller than R47.
His Shield is called Line of Scrimmage and it allows Gridiron to use 3 different abilities besides his ultimate.

The first is [b]Plasma Screen[/b] which makes him able to cover an even larger portion of the goal.

The second is [b]Shockwave[/b] which pushes the ball and other characters away from Gridiron.

The third is [b]Hail Mary[/b] which consumes the remaining Ability Points (AP) to create a magnetic field which pulls in the ball and then sends it flying out when released.

These three abilities all use AP which are obtained throughout the game.

Gridiron can get AP in 3 different ways:

1.	Ball hog: Gridiron gains AP when he hits the ball.
2.	Punching Bag: Gridiron gains AP after he body blocks the shot.
3.	Gameday: While not using abilities, Gridiron slowly generates AP overtime.

[b]Garbage Day[/b] is the name of Gridirons ultimate. The function is very similar to Hail Mary, but instead of just the ball, it pulls in everything and with a strong force shoots it back out.

An explanation of Gridiron and his skills can be seen in this video

[previewyoutube=2THolD8KCds;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]
Dragon Stadium[/b]

In this patch our new Dragon Stadium is released. Unlike the Great Harbor Arena, which has a more “underground” feeling to it, the new Dragon Stadium is where the real big games are played.

If you missed out on our previous article which covered how the Dragon Stadium was designed, you can read it here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1059110/announcements/detail/2216278688533704223
Or if you just really want to see what it looks like, you can check out our Dragon Stadium Trailer here:

[previewyoutube=SkxTrRsC6D4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New music[/b]

Are you ready to kick back and enjoy these funky vibes for next time you are hanging out in our game lobby? This sweet tune is made by Sean Garavan, a handsome English producer who makes music that will melt your heart.

Check out our lobby music here:

[previewyoutube=Hzxg00POiiI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Rocket Fist[/b]

How about a new item to bring out more chaos and variety to the game? Rocket fist is perfect for this purpose. Similar to Iron Ball, when you see the lock on symbol on the ball, you can fire of a rocket that punches to ball out of the hands of your opponents.

Here is a short video where you can see how the Rocket Fist works:

[previewyoutube=OpP27IQnhQM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Pink Buff[/b]

Pink has not been picked that much recently and we have noticed that especially in our more competitive tournaments she is rarely picked. We think it is a shame to leave her on the bench, so we have hired a personal trainer for her, and she is now in tip top shape!

- After many hours on the treadmill, she is now much faster than before. In fact, she is so fast now that she can almost compete with Pai. Of course, only if he doesn’t cheat and use his Light Dash.

- Pinks ultimate has been upgraded as well. Well in fact it is already really strong, so we have just made it a bit smoother than before.

- Pinks right click ability, the Color Cannon has had its animation time shortened. This means that she is now able to shoot it out faster than before.

- And finally, we have increased the charging speed of her color cannon. So she will be able to use it a lot more often than she was able to previously.

So, don’t be shy to pick Pink from now on, she won’t bite. Or will she?

We also have a few extra patches which will be posted out when we update the game.

And don’t forget to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw]Discord[/url] to meet new friends to play with:


Happy gaming!!!

-	The Devs

notes.title: About Super Buckyball Tournament 5th Character
notes.content:
[h2][b]About Super Buckyball Tournament 5th Character[/b][/h2]


It has now been 2 weeks since we launched SBT into open development. First, we thank all players who have participated and played our game so far. We received a bunch of great player feedback and all the pressure u guys have given us has motivated us to work harder and to speed up the development process.

Last weekend, we hosted the first ever SBT community tournament in China. It was a small tourney between 8 teams, randomly filled up by the top 24 players in the leaderboard. The matches were awesome, and some good players are emerging. we’ve uploaded some highlights on YouTube. So yeah check it out to see how the best Chinese players are doing (Link).

What is very evident in the tournament and the overall gameplay from the last 2 weeks is that it is very difficult to play defence for most people and especially Pai and Lang are a bit OP at the moment. Especially there is a Pai player in the tournament who can turn and sprint while still in the air, then bypass the defence and score, not just in 1v1 situation with goalie, but even when up against 2 defensive players.

Even with strong goalie players, the offence still seems much stronger than the defence which puts a lot of importance on who is better at controlling and keeping the ball throughout the game.

We are now about to put more balance into the game. Not by making the offensive players weaker, but to add better defence.

Right now, R47 is the main goalkeeper for most matches. He is excellent at ball control and is pretty agile despite being such a large robot. In order to play R47 well, it mainly comes down to player’s individual controls (jumping, punching & positioning etc.) and technical abilities. Overall, R47 is not completed positioned as a goalkeeper, he’s just more suited right now due to his bigger size. 

For some time, we have been working on creating a character that is better fitted for Goalie
by nature. This character would have to be big like R47 to easily block the shots, as well as having more emphasize on abilities to further increase his goalkeeping techniques. 

[b]Here is some initial concept for this character:[/b]

Obviously, the one with the shield won the vote and we started to make the concept into reality. Besides the whole batting thing is already used by R47.

Here were a few inspirations we had for the design

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0oFzzdV.jpg[/img]

And finally, here we have the upcoming character, Bubba.
Yes, please give us all your Shrimp boat jokes! :P

When this guy comes out, a whole new variety of gameplay and fun will be added to SBT.

[b]He will be part of the Main May Patch that is coming out sometime in May. More updates on the abilities and the actual date of his release is coming later. Stay tuned![/b]
[b]
Feedback is appreciated on email: sbt@pathea.net

notes.title: Super Buckyball Tournament Open Development Announcement
notes.content:
Super Buckyball Tournament is here to stay!!
Last week, we opened our servers in Europe, China and North America. 
Originally, we were a bit nervous about putting the game online, as there is always more stuff that can be added to make it better. But we are super stoked to see that people are liking our game and we appreciate all the feedback we have received over the past couple of days.
So, thank you so much for that!!!
 
As a result, we have decided to keep SBT in open development so we can share the fun with our fans, while we keep on adding more cool stuff. We also really want to know any feedback you guys have for us so we can create a game that fits not just the vision of our studio, but also the vision of our fans.
Here is a small list of things that we have prepared recently which are included in the latest build:
-        We Polished and redesigning our stadium as well as the characters Pink, Pai and R47
-        We added another character “Lang”, 
-        We gave all characters a secondary ability which can be used by pressing right-click, as well as some unique passives for the different characters.
-        We did a lot of work on the lobby and on the main page animation. 
-        UI both in-game and in the lobby (this still needs a lot of work, so please be patient with us).
-        A new ranking system and a leaderboard has been added 
-        End of game scoreboard has been added to see some stats from the game just played
-        We have added voice chat and text chat so players can communicate while playing. (not much testing has been done on this yet, but we will work on improving its function and UI soon)
 
The development has been following our vision for the game which is to make a highly competitive 3rd person sports game with a strong emphasis on teamplay. In order to develop the game in this direction, we have been trying to emulate certain aspects of real-life sports to find which elements create a stronger sense of competition and which elements create more reliance on teamwork. We have put a lot of work, sweat and blood and tears into this game. Actually, not so much blood, but many evenings of overtime for sure. 
So, if you love the game send us some super awesome, great and excellent feedback!
If you don’t love the game yet, send us your thoughts as well!
Email for feedback: sbt@pathea.net
Learn more about SBT on Twitter and join our community on Discord!
And make sure to wishlist!
 
Enjoy,
-        The SBT Devs
